text: Lion's Mane & Ashwagandha: I'm not advising either one, even though lots of people take them for focus and stress. That's because in rare cases people on forums and YouTube say they were left with anhedonia (when nothing feels good anymore) and sexual dysfunction that stuck around even after they stopped taking them, which some call post-ashwa or post-lion's mane syndrome. The same thing is a known risk with SSRI antidepressants and finasteride, the hair-loss drug, so these reports aren't as far-fetched as they might sound.
section: A Complete Guide to Bio-De-Armoring, the warnings: a new item after the Cognitive Warning
reader: an adult with trauma reading the warnings at the top before starting, who may already take lion's mane or ashwagandha, or be thinking of adding them for focus or stress

checked.point: lasting sexual dysfunction is a known risk after SSRIs and finasteride
checked.found: the EMA recognized lasting sexual dysfunction after SSRIs and SNRIs in June 2019; the FDA added sexual problems continuing after stopping to finasteride's labels in 2011 and 2012 (x1122a/WARNINGS-SOURCES.md)
